Happiness is within reach in the driver-focused
interior of the Tiguan. Enjoy personal space and
cargo space with 40/20/40-split folding rear seats.
Grab the leather-wrapped, multi-function steering
wheel, and enjoy its versatility and all of the
premium amenities under its available panoramic
sunroof. The Tiguan can make you feel at home
when you roam.
FEATURES
Heated front seats with V-Tex leatherette seating surfaces
Leather-wrapped, multi-function steering wheel
Glovebox with adjustable cooling feature
Keyless access with push-button start*
AVAILABLE FEATURES
Panoramic sunroof
Leather seating surfaces
12-way power-adjustable front seats
Climatronic® dual-zone automatic climate control
Some like it hot. Some like it cold. Thankfully, with available
dual-zone climate control, you and your passenger can sit in
your own comfort zone.
Your happy place. In any place.
40/20/40-split folding rear seats
There are times when a 60/40 split just isn’t enough. The Tiguan
lets you fold down one or both sides, or even just the middle, to
help maximize flexibility and cargo space.
SEL shown in Sandstone leather

Add more Volkswagen
to your Volkswagen.
Specifically designed and created to fit your Volkswagen model, this diverse lineup
